execution: decide at close, fill at next open, long-only, no leverage
hypothesis: Shen, Urquhart and Wang (2022) report that the first period of the day predicts the last period for Bitcoin, more strongly with high volume. Replication after 2022 is unknown. A 2-hour holding period at 20 bps round trip is cost-hostile, so this is included mainly as a falsification.
rules: Hourly bars, day = UTC date. First period = open 00:00 to open 04:00; its volume = sum of the four hourly volumes.
At the close of the 21:00 bar trade only if the first-period return > 0 AND its volume ranks >= 80th percentile among the last 60 days (including today).
If so hold for the bars opening at 22:00 and 23:00 (exit at the 00:00 open), weight 1/3 per asset.
Decide at the bar close, fill at the next bar open, long-only, no leverage.
status: research only; not a lab Critic PASS
